name: Maine
seasonal_phrase: summer coastal tourism, fall foliage season, and ski season in the western mountains

cities.name: Portland
cities.blurb: We place and service ATMs across Portland, the largest city in Maine. The Old Port is packed with bars, restaurants, breweries, boutiques, and hotels along cobblestone streets near the working waterfront, while the Arts District along Congress Street hosts music venues, cafes, and salons. The East End and Munjoy Hill have neighborhood pubs and corner stores, and dispensaries throughout the city see steady traffic. Summer cruise ships and year-round food tourism keep cash demand high, and our technicians are based locally.

cities.name: South Portland
cities.blurb: South Portland sits directly across the harbor from Portland, and we place and service ATMs at businesses throughout the city and neighboring Scarborough and Westbrook. The Maine Mall area along Maine Mall Road and Running Hill Road is the largest retail district in the state, lined with restaurants, hotels, convenience stores, gas stations, and dispensaries. Knightville and Mill Creek host cafes, pubs, and salons, while Willard Beach and Bug Light Park draw summer visitors to nearby restaurants and ice cream shops.

cities.name: Lewiston
cities.blurb: We place and service ATMs in Lewiston and Auburn, the twin cities on the Androscoggin River. Lisbon Street in Downtown Lewiston hosts bars, restaurants, cafes, and salons in historic storefronts, and the Bates College campus keeps nearby pubs and coffee shops busy through the school year. Center Street in Auburn and Sabattus Street in Lewiston are lined with convenience stores, gas stations, dispensaries, and shopping plazas around the Auburn Mall, while the Androscoggin Bank Colisee hosts hockey and concerts.

cities.name: Bangor
cities.blurb: Bangor is the commercial hub of eastern and northern Maine, and we place and service ATMs at businesses throughout the city. Downtown Bangor along Main Street and the waterfront hosts bars, restaurants, breweries, and salons, and the Maine Savings Amphitheater brings large summer concert crowds. Hollywood Casino sits near the riverfront, while Stillwater Avenue and Hogan Road are lined with convenience stores, gas stations, hotels, dispensaries, and shopping plazas around the Bangor Mall. The University of Maine in nearby Orono adds student traffic.

cities.name: Augusta
cities.blurb: We place and service ATMs in Augusta, the state capital on the Kennebec River. Water Street in Downtown Augusta hosts restaurants, bars, cafes, and salons that serve state employees, legislators, and visitors to the Maine State House, while the Civic Center Drive and Western Avenue corridors are lined with convenience stores, gas stations, hotels, dispensaries, and shopping plazas around the Marketplace at Augusta. The Augusta Civic Center hosts trade shows and concerts, and Interstate 95 brings steady traveler traffic.

cities.name: Waterville
cities.blurb: Waterville is a college town on the Kennebec River midway between Augusta and Bangor, and we place and service ATMs at businesses across the city. Main Street in Downtown Waterville has been revitalized with restaurants, bars, cafes, and the Paul J. Schupf Art Center, and the Colby College campus keeps nearby pubs and coffee shops busy through the school year. Kennedy Memorial Drive and the Interstate 95 exits are lined with convenience stores, gas stations, hotels, dispensaries, and shopping plazas.

cities.name: Biddeford
cities.blurb: We place and service ATMs in Biddeford and Saco, the twin mill cities on the Saco River. The Pepperell Mill campus and Main Street in Downtown Biddeford have become a hub of restaurants, breweries, cafes, and salons, while the University of New England campus adds student traffic. Route 1 and Alfred Street are lined with convenience stores, gas stations, dispensaries, and shopping plazas, and the Biddeford Pool and Old Orchard Beach area just north brings large crowds of summer tourists to bars, arcades, and hotels.

cities.name: Bar Harbor
cities.blurb: Bar Harbor is the gateway to Acadia National Park and one of the busiest tourist towns in New England each summer, and we place and service ATMs at businesses on Mount Desert Island and the surrounding coast. Main Street and Cottage Street in the village are packed with restaurants, bars, ice cream shops, boutiques, and hotels, and cruise ship days bring thousands of extra visitors. Ellsworth on the mainland hosts convenience stores, gas stations, dispensaries, and shopping plazas along High Street that serve the whole region.

cities.name: Presque Isle
cities.blurb: We place and service ATMs in Presque Isle, the commercial center of Aroostook County in far northern Maine. Main Street in Downtown Presque Isle hosts restaurants, bars, cafes, and salons, while the Aroostook Centre Mall area and US 1 are lined with convenience stores, gas stations, hotels, and dispensaries that serve customers from Caribou, Fort Fairfield, and across the Canadian border. The Northern Maine Fair each summer and the potato harvest each fall bring seasonal spikes in traffic to local businesses.
